expected_diagnosis: Path MTU/PMTUD issue suspected; probe alone is not final proof.
recommended_next_checks: Check tunnel MTU, tcpdump ICMP frag-needed, tracepath.
resolution_guidance: Correct MTU/MSS with network owner; avoid blind global changes.
verification: Large transfers complete through VPN without stalls.
escalate_when: Provider tunnel or upstream PMTUD blocked.
production_warning: Không áp dụng lệnh chỉnh sửa trên VPS khách hàng khi chưa có quyền, backup và kế hoạch rollback.
